cues.en: Hi and welcome to another episode of the Framedroming video podcast.
cues.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到又一期 Framedroming 视频播客。

cues.en: Today, I want to show you a couple of exercises
cues.zh: 今天我想给你们展示几个练习，

cues.en: that
can help you to prevent problems such as tendonitis or carpal tunnel, or if you have this kind of problem, it can also help you to deal with it.
cues.zh: 能帮你预防腱鞘炎或腕管综合征之类的问题；如果你已经有这类问题，也能帮你应对。

cues.en: As percussionists, this is a very sensitive area and we use it a lot and
cues.zh: 作为打击乐手，这是非常敏感的部位，我们经常用到它，而且

cues.en: sometimes we can get problems.
So the idea is,
the basic idea of these exercises is to stretch and the tendons that go from the shoulders, the forearm, through the wrist, to your hands and fingers.
cues.zh: 这些练习的基本思路是拉伸从肩膀、前臂、经过手腕，一直延伸到手掌和手指的肌腱。

cues.en: And there
are three basic exercises.
For the first one,
just reach forward with your arms, keep your shoulders relaxed
and the arms straight
and then
put the thumbs down and grab the thumbs with your fingers and hands and now
cues.zh: 拇指朝下，用手指和手抓住拇指，现在

cues.en: pull them downwards
so that this part,
this tendon that goes up here, you should feel a stretch there.
cues.zh: 这条往上走的肌腱，你应该能感觉到拉伸。

cues.en: And you should keep this kind of stretches for about eight to ten seconds. So
cues.zh: 每种拉伸保持大约八到十秒。所以

cues.en: this is number one. Number two,
you hold one arm forward,
you bend it once
and twice,
once here and once here, and you reach around with the other hand
cues.zh: 在这里弯一次，再在这里弯一次，然后用另一只手绕过去

cues.en: and pull.
So that this part
here you should feel a stretch here.
cues.zh: 这里，你应该能感觉到拉伸。

cues.en: And
the same thing with the other hand. And
again keep
each of these stretches for about eight to ten seconds.
cues.zh: 每个拉伸动作大约八到十秒。

cues.en: And the third one,
you can do against the wall for example.
You put one arm forward with the fingers and thumb pointing down
cues.zh: 一只手臂向前伸直，手指和大拇指朝下

cues.en: and this will already stretch this part
cues.zh: 这样就已经能拉伸到这个部位了

cues.en: and then you can reach around with the other hand and pull the thumb upwards.
cues.zh: 然后用另一只手绕过来，把大拇指往上拉。

cues.en: And this is for the tendon that goes from the thumb to the inside of your wrist up here. And I had tendonitis for a very long time
cues.zh: 这是为了拉伸从大拇指延伸到手腕内侧这里的肌腱。我曾经得过很长时间的腱鞘炎，

cues.en: it
took me a while until I figured out what to do about it. And these stretches, they helped me they helped me a lot, especially the last one.
cues.zh: 花了好久才摸索出应对办法。这些拉伸动作帮了我很多，尤其是最后一个。

cues.en: If you have some kind of problem in this area,
cues.zh: 如果你在这个部位也有类似的问题，

cues.en: will...
When you find the right stretch, you will feel it will be painful.
cues.zh: 当你做对拉伸动作时，会感觉到一阵疼痛。

cues.en: That's because
the idea is to stretch the shortened tendons so that they can relax again.
cues.zh: 其原理是拉伸紧绷缩短的肌腱，让它们重新放松下来。

cues.en: If you stretch a tendon that is inflamed,
cues.zh: 如果你拉伸一根正在发炎的肌腱，

cues.en: then there's gonna be some pain. That's okay, but it... Well, don't push it too much, but just so much that you feel that you actually get a stretch there.
cues.zh: 肯定会有点疼。这没关系，但……千万别太勉强，只要能明显感觉到拉伸感就行。

cues.en: And you can do it, like, once every hour, And your general state already should be better, a little bit better after one or two days.
cues.zh: 你可以大概每小时做一次，一两天后，整体状况应该就会有所好转。

cues.en: Yeah. If you can consult with a physicist, of course, that's the best way to do it.
cues.zh: 当然，能咨询专业医师肯定是最好的。

cues.en: Okay. Well...
Oh, yeah. There's another
short series of exercises for the carpal tunnel.
The carpal tunnel is is this area where all the tendons go through,
cues.zh: 腕管就是所有肌腱穿过的这块区域，

cues.en: and this
is very simple. You just put your arms forward.
cues.zh: 非常简单。只要双臂向前伸直。

cues.en: You
stretch your hands backwards. This is the first
cues.zh: 双手手掌向后扳。这是第

cues.en: part.
Second one, you keep them forward and just
cues.zh: 第二个，你让它们保持朝前，然后

cues.en: flinch them to a fist
for another
couple of seconds.
And the third part,
you keep the fist and then you stretch,
you move your hand down.
Okay.
I hope that helps. If you have some problem there, you can also write me an email to david@framerams.de
cues.zh: 希望这有帮助。如果你那边有什么问题，也可以给我发邮件到 david@framerams.de

cues.en: if you have any more questions.
That's it for today, the Frameraming video podcast without Framerams,
cues.zh: 今天就到这里，这是没有 Framerams 的 Frameraming 视频播客，

cues.en: and I'll see you next time.
